reviews.title: Love it.. However
reviews.text: I really like this app, as do the recipients of my cards. However, I cannot understand why the developers can’t integrate more seamlessly with my Contacts. It is clunky and slow. If they could fix this, I’d give it 5 stars.

reviews.title: Love it, so personal
reviews.text: I love the ease of getting to use my own photos and my own handwriting in making something special for sending snail mail. I created a Felt Bomb for my SIL and it was a huge success and so easy to do. I love sharing memories and little “thinking of you’s” and this is such a fun way to do it. I’ve even started sending some to myself to remember special moments with my toddler. They are fun to collect as well. I tell everyone about this app. It’s great! Thanks for creating and maintaining a wonderful product.

reviews.title: Cheaper than store cards!
reviews.text: You can infinitely personalize these and even send physical objects! Send 1 or as many as you want! I’ve already sent 2 cards & am very satisfied with this app. No subscription required for any features either. 10 out of 10 recommend!

reviews.title: The perfect Note
reviews.text: Love being able to send these cards to family and friends, they always bring a smile.

reviews.title: The fix on the size of the card for typing
reviews.text: Prior to this fix..the card at the top of the screen was very small.  I was unable to type on it as I could not see what I was typing.  I could do a card on my iPhone, but not my iPad.  I could hand write on the iPad, but prefer typing.  This new update will increase my use of Felt!  Thanks you!

reviews.title: Cost
reviews.text: The cost has gone up. The only reason why I was ordering from felt was because of the price of the cost of the card. Now it cost more to go to the store and buy one and send it out so I prefer that thank you.

reviews.title: Order never delivered
reviews.text: I tried on several occasions to receive a refund for 2 separate orders never delivered and still haven’t received a refund.

reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: This card service is the best! Such an easy and affordable way to send cards and photos! They have awesome customizable cards. Everybody loves them!

reviews.title: Thank yous
reviews.text: My favorite way to send thank yous, especially for my kiddos’ birthday gifts—a heartfelt note + a picture of the recipient with my children is super special & it’s cheaper to design & send from home than a card from the store! And I don’t even have to even leave my house!

reviews.title: Worst service
reviews.text: Do not use this service. Said they were sending card July 1. Never did. I contacted them 10 days later. Sent three messages. They did not reply until 4 days later . Let’s see if they will send the card.

reviews.title: Fantastic app
reviews.text: This app is easy to use and I end up sending lots more “snail mail” than I would without it. Cards come back beautiful and I’m happy to have this way to keep in touch. Subscription keeps prices affordable and I’ve been using it for about 3 years.

reviews.title: Stark tank
reviews.text: I seen this on Shark Tank and I thought I’d give it a try, I don’t know when exactly it came into the market. I’m thinking seven years ago five years ago, found them like I did groove book back in the day. I hope it’s as beautiful as it looks.

reviews.title: Reminded it is awful
reviews.text: Always. Always cannot get this app to work well. Always glitchy removes my photos or text I’ve written randomly. Always having connectivity issues. Last time it removed my entire card I had with a connection issue. Likely last time I’ll use this service. Just awful app.

reviews.title: Reminder it’s easy to show you care!
reviews.text: Such a great way to send cards that are more meaningful to family, friends and coworkers!

reviews.title: Subscription TRAP
reviews.text: You lose the credits you’ve paid for when you discontinue your subscription. Plus, they keep charging you every month even when you aren’t using the service. Terrible business practice.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: Love this app and I use it all the time. However… patience is needed as it can be glitchy and and slow.

reviews.title: Needs Better UI
reviews.text: I looooove this app. I do. But the UI is a little rough. The buttons on the bottom aren’t easy to click. They’re like small and out of screen. I’m on iPhone 16.

reviews.title: Greatest Card App!
reviews.text: Love using Felt! Easy and creative way to send messages to all the important people in your life!

reviews.title: Great service app
reviews.text: I have used Felt for several years and they have never failed to cheer someone’s day! My son was recently at basic training and this was a fun way to send a current pic of the things going on at home (our dogs, a 5k race, the Christmas lights, etc). I sometimes add in a treat with cards to my pen pal, and might I say, this app is allowing me to rekindle the pen pal fun! Easy to use. They note the address across the top of the screen if you want to handwrite it instead of a typed address. Pics quickly upload to the card, you can even duplicate the card if you want to send the exact same thing to multiple people.

reviews.title: I love how easy it is.
reviews.text: This app makes it so easy to send off a card whether it’s for birthdays or thank you or get well. It’s such a nice personal touch to be able to hand write. Just love it.

reviews.title: Family Loves my Monthly Cards
reviews.text: When our kid was a toddler I realized how quickly time was moving, and how our relatives who lived far away never got to witness her growth. So I started sending monthly cards to them. Just a few photos and a few quick updates on our lives. “Card day” is now something the grandparents and aunties look forward to every month. This app is an integral part of keeping our family connected.

reviews.title: Love felt!
reviews.text: The square cards look so nice ❤️

reviews.title: Valentine disappointment
reviews.text: This was delivered past than what was originally agreed to. Still hasn’t arrived!! Bogus deal!

reviews.title: Best birthday gifts
reviews.text: I have been sending Felt cards for years and the recipients LOVE them and hold on to them. They are such meaningful, personalized gifts and this app makes it so easy and the price is unbeatable, especially because it includes shipping.

reviews.title: The best cards!
reviews.text: So easy to use and everyone loves receiving these cards!

reviews.title: Poor Delivery Times
reviews.text: Been a customer for 2 years. More often than not, I would order a card, send it out, only to find out the card did not make it for 2-3 weeks later. Not only was I disappointed, it let down the person I sent it to - made me look bad, and CANNOT be counted on as a reliable service. These are going to standard US addresses - just 3 states away. Completely unacceptable. I sent another card via USPS snail mail to compare and received in 2 days. Let me sum up - 2 Days vs 2 WEEKS. This has happened at least 50% of the time sending cards from Felt. Do you want to take that chance?

reviews.title: Favorite App!
reviews.text: I’ve used Felt App for years and I love it! I like how it saves my addresses - makes Christmas cards extra easy!

reviews.title: Buggy UI
reviews.text: The tab bar is half cutoff on the bottom.

reviews.title: A home run!!
reviews.text: I’ve been using FELT cars for years. I recommend this to everybody. Where can you find a product that is incredibly easy to use, let you be creative, you can use it anytime day or night, you can send it virtually anywhere, and you can send little gifts and inserts with it? And let’s not forget the incredible Customer Service! I have never had a problem with them ever. That’s also pretty darn good.

reviews.title: SO SLOW
reviews.text: This application is VERY hard to navigate the writing tool. After taking 30 min to get a card done. The app cleared out my work, sending a traditional card.

reviews.title: My favorite Christmas Cards! The only one of their kind
reviews.text: I enjoy telling our story through Felt Christmas cards, and this is the best app to do it on

reviews.title: Felt is Great!
reviews.text: I love the Felt app!  I love being able to send custom cards with meaningful photos to special people in my life.  It is so fun to see the cards I sent them displayed on refrigerators when I visit their homes.  Someone recently mentioned a card I had sent the 3 years ago.  That’s the real reason I like felt cards, they make a lasting impression!

reviews.title: Efficient, Thoughtful Way to Share Love!
reviews.text: Just heard about this app from a friend today.  HUGE blessing to get the card out before I get back into my busy, crazy life!  Thanks so much!!!

reviews.title: Having fun
reviews.text:
I send a card and a small gift to my 8 grandchildren every month!
They love them! 
This is so easy and convenient for me to do this! 
I love Felt!

reviews.title: Uploading pictures
reviews.text: I love this app, but lately I've tried to upload a picture and it just swirls and doesn't add the pictures.

reviews.title: It’s a nice touch to create one-of-a-kind cards
reviews.text: I really enjoy creating special cards for my friends and family. It’s far more satisfying than buying a mass produced card. I enjoy doing it and hope they enjoy receiving it.

reviews.title: One of my favorite app downloads of all time
reviews.text: I received a card like this in the mail and thought it was so cool that I asked her where she had it made.  That was years ago and I’ve been a huge fan ever since. Sending cards in the mail is something that should never go away. I truly believe it can make a persons entire day. When you can add personal pictures and even ‘handwrite’ the card still, it’s even better. This is a monthly membership I’ve never thought of canceling.

reviews.title: Cards when I need them
reviews.text:
Although  I have cards, I don't always have the card I need.  Felt always has the right card.
I also don't have to find the right postage.

All in all, a handy App I use monthly.

reviews.text: I always use this cards for special occasions! :)

reviews.title: Love delivered
reviews.text: The only subscription I never ever regret. Thanks for helping me stay in touch!

reviews.text: Great concept and cards. App is buggy and customer service is not great at all. I’ve ordered many times and had issues with receiving which that part could be more likely a post office problem.  Nice while it lasted. Uninstalling.

reviews.text: wish i could successfully apply my own handwriting gor a more personal feel- otherwise love it! It's really convenient and an actual card always brings a smile

reviews.text: I sent emails to customer service asking for an update about the card and the delivery. I still have not received any response and it’s been a couple of days now.

reviews.title: Slow shipping
reviews.text: This is a cool concept but you definitely need to plan way ahead of when you need the card.  I’m in LA and expected wait time (per the tracking/support) is 10 days for 1 card coming from TX - no text just a photo!  I’m on day 8 and still waiting.

reviews.title: Great concept, clunky execution
reviews.text: I love the concept of this app, but I find the execution lacking. I often have frustrations with using this, and I’ve been disappointed that they haven’t been updates to alleviate that. It always takes longer than I think it should to create the card that I want. If they could smooth out the bumps that would be amazing. Otherwise I’m probably going to cancel my subscription soon.

reviews.title: Great app but super slow
reviews.text: Love the app. Using it- plan to keep using it, but it’s so slow (only app on my phone that’s slow). It has taken 1-2 hours just to complete the card, and I’m pretty tech savvy.

reviews.title: Cards a nice, but delivery time is ridiculously slow
reviews.text:
I love the concept of Felt and the quality of the cards is great, but the shipping is painfully slow. I subscribed and ordered my first card for Father’s Day on June 7—it was marked as mailed out on June 9, yet it still didn’t arrive by June 15 (Father’s Day). That’s really disappointing for something time-sensitive like a holiday.

Another frustrating thing is how the subscription works. If you’ve used all your monthly credits—for example, in July—you can’t schedule a card for early August unless you buy an extra one, even though your new credits are coming soon. That wouldn’t be a huge issue if the shipping wasn’t already so slow and unreliable. It just makes planning ahead feel unnecessarily complicated.

I want to love Felt, but until they improve their delivery speeds or make scheduling more flexible, it’s hard to rely on them for important occasions.

reviews.title: Memories
reviews.text: Felt has been a wonderful way to share memories with family members. Our grandsons love saving their felt photos and our hope is that they will cherish the memories later.

reviews.title: Great cards!
reviews.text: Really fun way to send personalized cards. I love that you can add several pictures and write your own messages. Reasonably priced, and fast shipping/delivery. Love that you can send cards internationally, too. Only complaint is that app is a little glitchy so it can take some patience.
